'''Galduran Calrissian''' was an individual who gained a measure of notoriety for running a [[Galduran Calrissian's smuggling ring|smuggling ring]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]],<ref name="KOTOR" /> a region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that was under the control of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] with a crime-oriented culture.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Calrissian's venture was not sanctioned, and he eventually became a liability to the authorities. At the time being the last of his family line, at one point Calrissian became cornered, being forced to sell off property including his personal items in order to survive. Those included a [[Calrissian's utility belt|utility belt]] that,<ref name="KOTOR" /> in [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="KOTORDate">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' to [[3956 BBY]].</ref> the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Crattis Yurkal]] was selling on<ref name="KOTOR" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:KotOR_Cover.png|thumb|right|250px|Galduran Calrissian was introduced in ''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic''.]]
Galduran Calrissian was first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''.<ref name="KOTOR" /> [[Prima Games]]' accompanying [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|Official Strategy Guide]] for the game spelled his first name "Garduran," which this article assumes to be erroneous.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

Galduran shared his last name with [[Raan Calrissian]]<ref name="Tethan">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]''</ref> and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> Raan was introduced in [[2010]] and,<ref name="Tethan" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]'' is set during the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> was transporting a shipment of [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] aboard his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Jostaar Express]]''<ref name="Tethan" />&mdash;which in turn shared its name with the [[Kibilini sector/Legends|Kibilini sector's]] [[Jostaar system/Legends|Jostaar system]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>&mdash;to a client on<ref name="Tethan" /> the Kibilini [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC Socorro">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Socorro system/Legends|Socorro system]]</ref> world<ref name="TEA" /> [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]].<ref name="Tethan" /> Lando, who originated in [[1980]],<ref name="Making">''[[The Making of The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> was a [[Socorran]]<ref name="Vegas">{{SW|url=news/viva-space-vegas-the-history-of-the-marvelous-wheel-part-1|series=Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="ESB" /> smuggler<ref name="TEA" /> [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name-"LandoBirthYear">{{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}} states that [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] thirty-one [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> with the line "What have we here?" being a part of both Raan and Lando's opening dialogue.<ref name="Tethan" /><ref name="ESB" />
